# 2.161.0
First packaged release.
- **Install from a signed package.** A notarized `.pkg` installer sets up Stenographer without needing a source checkout. An optional component installs the `claude-account` shell integration (off by default). - **Automatic updates.** Stenographer now checks for updates in the background and offers them from a new **Check for Updates…** menu item. - **Smoother updates.** After installing an update, Stenographer finishes its own setup automatically — no manual steps required. - **The command-line tool is now `snog`.** It replaces `stenographer`; setup moves your status line over to it automatically. - **Burn rate in Account Quotas.** Each account shows how fast it is using its quota, accounts can be reordered, and a seal marks each quota's state. - **Reliable account switching.** Switching Claude accounts no longer loops on password prompts, installs an expired login, or loses a renewed token.
